description: This file defines the SugarCronJobs class, which manages the cron job execution cycle in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes configuration, job scheduling, execution, error handling, and system throttling mechanisms.

classes.name: SugarCronJobs
classes.description: A class responsible for managing and executing scheduled jobs within SuiteCRM, including job queue management, scheduling, throttling, and error handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the cron job manager with configuration settings and prepares the job queue.

methods.name: markLastRun
methods.description: Records the last run time of the cron process into a lock file.

methods.name: throttle
methods.description: Checks if the cron jobs are being invoked too frequently based on minimum interval settings.

methods.name: jobFailed
methods.description: Handles the scenario where a job fails during execution, logging the failure.

methods.name: unexpectedExit
methods.description: Shutdown handler to manage unexpected termination and mark current job as failed.

methods.name: getMyId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the current cron process.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Runs a specified job and handles failure if the job does not execute successfully.

methods.name: runCycle
methods.description: Performs a full cron cycle including cleanup, scheduling, and execution of jobs within defined constraints.

methods.name: runOk
methods.description: Returns true if all jobs ran successfully in the last cycle, false otherwise.
